summary: IRSA Inversiones y Representaciones S.A. (NYSE: IRS; ByMA: IRSA) filed a 6-K furnishing its October 16, 2026 letter to the Bolsa de Comercio de Buenos Aires and the CNV, disclosing that on October 15, 2026 it repurchased USD 9 million aggregate principal of its Series XXV Notes issued June 8, 2026, equal to 18.0% of the series' outstanding principal, at 100.68% of principal. Repurchased notes will be held in treasury. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or regulatory clock disclosed. Watch residual float and any further buybacks.
